t: You're looking at the statue of W. G. Grace at Lord's Cricket Ground. It was made by the Australian sculptor Louis Laumen. Grace is remembered here as one of the sport's all-time greats. Known simply as WG, he played first-class cricket for a record-equalling forty-four seasons, from 1865 to 1908. He played for England in twenty-two Tests, and for Gloucestershire and the Marylebone Cricket Club, the MCC, which is the club based at Lord's.
